problem.title: Problem and Solution Approach
problem.problemText: In participation banking, campaign texts are written in different formats and with different terminology, making manual comparison difficult. This delays bank employees and customers in choosing the most advantageous product.
problem.solutionText: Collecting data via web scraping, analyzing texts and extracting information with Turkish NLP models, converting the extracted data into a standard, comparable format, and presenting the results to users through an interactive dashboard and a Q&A chatbot.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: To be the pioneer of natural language processing based comparison and analysis solutions in participation banking in Turkey.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: To automatically extract critical financial information from participation banks' product texts, providing bank employees and customers with clear, comparable, and accessible data.
